note: Phase 6 is executed by one owner on one branch, so there is a single lane. The manifest still exists because ownership is what makes 'which files may this change touch' checkable, and because contract, generated and forbidden paths must be explicit even when nobody can race for them.

forbiddenRationale.js/targets/architecture/arm64/**: Phase 6 must not change ARM64 behaviour to make RISC-V fit (INV-014).
forbiddenRationale.js/targets/architecture/x86_64/effects/*: Phase 5's x86 semantics are frozen; Phase 6 repairs generic contracts, never another architecture's lifter.
forbiddenRationale.js/core/identity/**: Artifact and instruction identity is a Phase 0/4 contract.
forbiddenRationale.tests/phase5/**: Phase 5 evidence may be re-run but not rewritten by Phase 6.
forbiddenRationale.docs/HEX_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.md: A phase may not edit the contract it is being judged against.

ownedWithConstraint.reports/phase5/**: Phase 5 evidence may be marked superseded with a pointer to the live gate, but its historical record must not be deleted or rewritten.
ownedWithConstraint.tests/capability-maturity.mjs: May be updated only to match repaired machine-readable capability truth, never to relax an assertion so an inflated claim passes.
